name: Hotel Miramar
stayType: Seafront hotel on the East Cliff
accommodation: Sea-view rooms, junior suites and inland rooms
suitableFor: Couples and families wanting a traditional seafront hotel
beachAccess: East Cliff, with sea and beach views; guests mention a short walk to the pier
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant No 43, Ocean Bar and Terrace, afternoon tea, garden, EV charging
overview: A traditional hotel on East Overcliff Drive on Bournemouth's East Cliff, looking out over the sea and beach. It offers sea-view rooms and junior suites, with a restaurant, bar and terrace, and the town centre and pier are within walking distance.
surfTripFit: Clifftop sea views let you check the swell from your room, with the zigzag paths down to the beach close by.
